title: How to start a psychology career in your 30's & beyond - DClinPsy - mature student, grief, turning 40

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能通过出卖时间赚钱之外还能赚到钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 索菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了这个项目，此后也一直支持两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得索菲的奖金以及我独家的支持套餐，不收取额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四个小组智囊团、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南梅森的礼物以及限时的一对一教练奖金。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名截止时间为11月16日星期一晚上10点。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: On today's episode, we are talking with Thomas, who is an incoming trainee clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中，我们邀请到了即将成为临床心理学培训生的托马斯。

sentences.en: We are talking about so many interesting things, namely being a slightly older applicant and also starting studying later in life as well,
sentences.zh: 我们聊了很多有趣的事情，也就是作为一个稍年长的申请者以及在晚年开始学习，

sentences.en: following revelations in a personal life that made existential ponderings happen.
sentences.zh: 此前个人生活中的一些启示引发了对存在的思考。

sentences.en: It's a fascinating listen.
sentences.zh: 这是一次非常引人入胜的访谈。

sentences.en: I hope you'll find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 我希望你会觉得它很有用。

sentences.en: And also stay tuned right to the end for Thomas's top tips on how to reduce burnouts along the way to becoming whatever psychologist you aim to be.
sentences.zh: 另外，请收看到最后，听听托马斯的顶级建议，了解如何在成为你目标心理学家的道路上减少倦怠。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你正准备成为一名心理学家，那就让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: It's an absolute pleasure to be bringing this podcast to you since December 2021, and I have no plans to stop.
sentences.zh: 自2021年12月以来，为您带来这个播客是一种绝对的荣幸，我没有计划停播。

sentences.en: So if you have any ideas for content you'd love to hear about, please do let me know.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果您对您想听的内容有什么想法，请务必让我知道。

sentences.en: Guest for today's episode did get in contact with me via LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 今天节目的嘉宾是通过领英与我取得联系的。

sentences.en: And I have to say the first time I didn't see the message, but he responded again in a message to something he'd heard me say in the podcast as a call out for if people had ideas.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，第一次我没有看到这条消息，但他再次发信息回复了我曾在播客中提到的一点，当时是在呼吁大家提出想法。

sentences.en: And that was about the age of you compared to your supervisor and how the dynamics play out.
sentences.zh: 那也就是关于你的年龄与你的主管相比以及这种动态是如何发挥作用的。

sentences.en: And that is absolutely something that's cropping up in today's episode.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是今天节目中会出现的话题。

sentences.en: And it's really fascinating stuff.
sentences.zh: 这些内容真的非常吸引人。

sentences.en: It's a really useful listen or watch if you're watching on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 如果你在YouTube上观看，这也是一次非常值得收听或观看的内容。

sentences.en: If you are watching on YouTube, please do take a moment to like, to subscribe, to put a comment in and to share the content.
sentences.zh: 如果你在YouTube上观看，请花一点时间点赞、订阅、发表评论并分享内容。

sentences.en: If you think, which I think, it's useful and other people might benefit too, please do also come along and discuss this episode in my free Facebook group,
sentences.zh: 如果你认为（我也这样认为）它很有用，其他人也可能会受益，也请来我的免费Facebook群组中讨论这一期节目，

sentences.en: which is the Aspiring Psychologist Community with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 即由玛丽安·特伦特博士创建的有抱负的心理学家社区。

sentences.en: If you are listening on Spotify or Apple, please do take a moment to rate and review.
sentences.zh: 如果你在Spotify或Apple上收听，请花一点时间进行评分和评价。

sentences.en: It really does mean so much.
sentences.zh: 这真的意义重大。

sentences.en: So with no further ado, let's plough on with this episode and I will catch you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 那么废话不多说，让我们继续这一期节目，我们稍后见。

sentences.en: So I just want to welcome along Thomas, an incoming trainee clinical psychologist to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我想欢迎即将成为临床心理学培训生的托马斯来到播客。

sentences.en: Hi, Thomas.
sentences.zh: 嗨，托马斯。

sentences.en: Hi, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 嗨，玛丽安。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: Oh, well, thank you for reaching out.
sentences.zh: 哦，谢谢你主动联系。

sentences.en: And I'm sorry that I did miss your first LinkedIn message, but persistence definitely pays off.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉我漏掉了你的第一条领英消息，但坚持确实有回报。

sentences.en: I am nothing if not persistent.
sentences.zh: 我这个人别的没有，就是坚持不懈。

sentences.en: That's for sure.
sentences.zh: 那是肯定的。

sentences.en: I love that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这样。

sentences.en: So we're going to hear about a variety of different reasons why I think that you make a great podcast guest and why our audience are going to really love what you've got to say.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们将听到各种不同的原因，为什么我认为你是一个很棒的播客嘉宾，以及为什么我们的观众会真正喜欢你要说的话。

sentences.en: For anybody watching on YouTube, you might well have noticed that Thomas is my age and we've also coordinated our outfits beautifully.
sentences.zh: 对于在YouTube上观看的任何人，你可能已经注意到托马斯和我同龄，而且我们的服装也搭配得很完美。

sentences.en: We've gone for the same shade of burnt orange.
sentences.zh: 我们都选择了相同的焦橙色。

sentences.en: So, yeah, you are 42.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，你42岁了。

sentences.en: Is that right, Thomas?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗，托马斯？

sentences.en: Yes, I am.
sentences.zh: 是的，我是。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Fellow 81 baby, maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许是81年的同龄人。

sentences.en: But how is 42 working out for you so far?
sentences.zh: 但是42岁目前对你来说感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: So far, it's been pretty great.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，感觉相当不错。

sentences.en: I think my 40s have so far been my best decade and I think the way it's shaping up, it's going to continue to go that way.
sentences.zh: 我认为我的40岁到目前为止是我最好的十年，而且我认为按照现在的发展势头，它会继续保持下去。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I think 40 is pretty great.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我认为40岁相当不错。

sentences.en: I'm quite glad to be here in my 40s.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴能来到40岁。

sentences.en: I know, I feel similarly and yet it was something I was dreading.
sentences.zh: 我知道，我有同感，然而这也是我曾经恐惧的事情。

sentences.en: I know it's something I spoke about on the podcast recently,
sentences.zh: 我知道这是我最近在播客中谈论过的事情，

sentences.en: but I really thought it was going to all be downhill and quite depressing and I'd feel awful and old and like my life was over.
sentences.zh: 但我真的以为一切都会走下坡路，非常压抑，我会觉得自己很糟糕、很老，就像我的生命已经结束了一样。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think I think in my 20s, well, I don't even think I even thought about getting to 40 or what that would look like.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想我在20多岁的时候，或者说我甚至没有想过要到40岁会是什么样子。

sentences.en: But I think I think it was probably like quite grey.
sentences.zh: 但我认为那可能相当灰暗。

sentences.en: Like visually in my mind, I think it was all in black and white and it was all quite boring and somber.
sentences.zh: 就像在我脑海中的视觉效果一样，我认为一切都是黑白的，而且相当无聊和阴沉。

sentences.en: But it isn't.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: It's burnt orange.
sentences.zh: 它是焦橙色的。

sentences.en: I was just thinking 40 is burnt orange colour, you know, so was it lavender and lilac is 70s and 80s, but clearly 40s is burnt orange.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚在想40岁是焦橙色的，你知道的，正如70年代和80年代是薰衣草紫和丁香紫，但很明显40岁是焦橙色。

sentences.en: But I think it didn't help me that when I was 39, just before the world ground to a halt with the pandemic, my eyes packed up and I suddenly needed glasses.
sentences.zh: 但对我没有帮助的是，自我39岁时，就在世界因大流行而陷入停顿之前，我的眼睛出了问题，我突然需要戴眼镜了。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, God, this is so depressing.
sentences.zh: 当时我想，哦，天哪，这太令人沮丧了。

sentences.en: This is just what my 40s is going to be.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的40岁吗。

sentences.en: There's going to be one ailment after another.
sentences.zh: 这将是一个接着一个的病痛。

sentences.en: Yeah, since leaving university, which maybe we'll come on to because I only recently left university.
sentences.zh: 是的，自从离开大学以来，也许我们会谈到这一点，因为我最近才离开大学。

sentences.en: Yeah, I got in.
sentences.zh: 是的，我进去了。

sentences.en: I got into my job and I started to get headaches and migraines.
sentences.zh: 我找到了工作，然后开始头痛和偏头痛。

sentences.en: So hence, hence, I also now wear glasses.
sentences.zh: 因此，因此，我现在也戴眼镜了。

sentences.en: And the yeah, the person who did my eye test, she did say, well, it's just a sign of ageing.
sentences.zh: 而且，给我做视力检查的人确实说过，这只是衰老的迹象。

sentences.en: I was like, oh, terrific.
sentences.zh: 我说，哦，太棒了。

sentences.en: Here it comes.
sentences.zh: 它来了。

sentences.en: It's already here.
sentences.zh: 它已经来了。

sentences.en: Here it comes.
sentences.zh: 它来了。

sentences.en: It's here.
sentences.zh: 它来了。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对的。

sentences.en: I've also got a very similar pair of glasses to you as well.
sentences.zh: 我也有一副和你非常相似的眼镜。

sentences.en: We could be like twins.
sentences.zh: 我们简直可以像双胞胎一样。

sentences.en: Burnt orange, black frame glasses.
sentences.zh: 焦橙色，黑色镜框眼镜。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So it's burnt orange and kind of roundish glasses as well.
sentences.zh: 所以是焦橙色和有点圆形的眼镜。

sentences.en: It's where it's at.
sentences.zh: 这就是潮流所在。

sentences.en: It's where all the cool kids hang out, I think.
sentences.zh: 我认为所有酷炫的人都在这里。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So, yeah, you mentioned there that you went to university a little later than probably the average listener would have done.
sentences.zh: 所以，你之前提到你上大学的时间比一般听众要晚一些。

sentences.en: Could you guide us through your steps a little bit, if that's OK?
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，你能带我们了解一下你的经历吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, so definitely older than the kind of typical.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对比典型年龄要大。

sentences.en: So I never went to university at the kind of typical age, partly because I never finished my A levels.
sentences.zh: 所以我从来没有在典型的年龄上大学，部分原因是我从未完成我的高级水平考试（A levels）。

sentences.en: So whoops.
sentences.zh: 所以，哎呀。

sentences.en: I tried, I tried twice and didn't get to the end either time.
sentences.zh: 我试过，我尝试了两次，但两次都没有读到最后。

sentences.en: So I wasn't qualified to go to university, but I also wasn't, I don't know, just personally, emotionally, developmentally qualified to take that either.
sentences.zh: 所以我没有资格上大学，而且我也，不知道，从个人、情感、发育上来说，我也没有做好准备。

sentences.en: So instead, I just spent a decade and a half moving from job to job, completely disparate squiggle of a path.
sentences.zh: 相反，我花了十五年时间从一份工作跳到另一份工作，走了一条完全不相干的曲折道路。

sentences.en: So I was, yeah, that was maybe 15 years.
sentences.zh: 所以，那大概是15年。

sentences.en: I guess I had a significant life event in my mid-30s.
sentences.zh: 我想我在30岁出头时经历了一次重大的人生事件。

sentences.en: It's the kind of, the kind of life event that makes you very quickly and clearly reassess what it is that you're doing, why you're doing it.
sentences.zh: 那是那种能让你非常迅速且清晰地重新评估你在做什么、你为什么这样做的重大人生事件。

sentences.en: And it kind of distills all of the nonsense that you tell yourself.
sentences.zh: 它有点像过滤掉了你对自己说的所有废话。

sentences.en: So that's what happened to me.
sentences.zh: 这就是发生在我身上的事情。

sentences.en: And I very quickly decided that enough was enough of not doing anything without a great deal of purpose or direction.
sentences.zh: 我很快就决定，不能再过这种没有明确目的或方向的生活了。

sentences.en: And to actually do the thing that secretly was the thing that I always wanted to do and the thing that I would always like to develop as, which is to be some kind of psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 而是真正去做那件我暗地里一直想做的事情，那件我一直想以此发展的领域，那就是成为某种心理学家。

sentences.en: So, yeah, so I went part-time in my job.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我把工作改成了兼职。

sentences.en: Not having any A-levels was a bit of a barrier, still a barrier to university.
sentences.zh: 没有A-level是一个有点阻碍，对上大学来说仍然是一个阻碍。

sentences.en: So I did an access to higher education course, which is a kind of part-time, part-ish time, one-year course, which is equivalent to A-levels.
sentences.zh: 所以我参加了高等教育预科课程（Access to Higher Education course），这是一种兼职的、部分时间的、为期一年的课程，相当于A-level。

sentences.en: And I did that in psychology, sociology and social policy.
sentences.zh: 我选修了心理学、社会学和社会政策专业。

sentences.en: And then from that, I got into my undergrad and that was in 2018.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，我考上了本科，那是2018年。

sentences.en: So I graduated 2021.
sentences.zh: 所以我2021年毕业。

sentences.en: So, yeah, not the typical timeline.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这不是典型的时间线。

sentences.en: Definitely not.
sentences.zh: 绝对不是。

sentences.en: But actually, you've encompassed a whole pandemic there as well.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，你也经历了一场大流行。

sentences.en: So you were studying your undergrad during that time?
sentences.zh: 所以你是在那段时期攻读本科的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it was epiphany term second year, wasn't it?
sentences.zh: 是的，那是第二年的显现学期，对吧？

sentences.en: So that's basically half of the degree and half of the experience of being at university was then kind of taken away from us.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上大学一半的学位和一半的体验就这样被剥夺了。

sentences.en: I think part of me actually still mourns the death of that third year in terms of the experience of it.
sentences.zh: 我想我内心深处其实仍在为大三体验的消亡而哀悼。

sentences.en: I know everyone will have their own version of this, but I think for me and maybe other people in my cohort, that was our experience of having that taken away.
sentences.zh: 我知道每个人都会有自己的感触，但对于我和我同龄的其他一些人来说，这就是我们被剥夺了这种体验的经历。

sentences.en: Which, yeah, I still wish there are things left undone, things left unsaid that always will be, which is a shame.
sentences.zh: 这使得，是的，我仍然希望有些事情没有做完，有些话没有说完，这总是会发生的，这很遗憾。

sentences.en: But like I said, everyone has their own version of that in some way.
sentences.zh: 但就像我说的，每个人以某种方式都有自己独特的版本。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对的。

sentences.en: I wrote some stuff for the media about grief linked to the pandemic that was not to do with death and dying.
sentences.zh: 我曾为媒体写过一些关于与大流行相关但与生死无关的悲伤的文章。

sentences.en: And there's so many things that so many of us missed out on.
sentences.zh: 我们许多人错过了太多的事情。

sentences.en: And like you said, that can't be, can't be undone.
sentences.zh: 就像你说的，这是无法改变、无法撤销的。

sentences.en: They can't, you can't get a do over, a redo on them.
sentences.zh: 它们不能，你无法重新来过，无法重做。

sentences.en: And it's okay to be sad and to grieve for something, even though you might not have lost somebody, you know, through death in the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 为某事感到悲伤和哀悼是可以的，即使你可能没有在大流行中失去通过死亡离去的某个人。

sentences.en: It's okay to grieve for important life events that didn't get to happen as they would have done otherwise.
sentences.zh: 为那些本该发生却未能如愿的重要人生事件感到悲伤是可以的。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对的。

sentences.en: I agree.
sentences.zh: 我同意。

sentences.en: I think there's a lot to be said for the death of a fantasy, a projected death.
sentences.zh: 我认为幻想的破灭，一种预期的破灭，有很多话要说。

sentences.en: And that plays out in my role as well, my current role, that I see what people imagine their future and their life is going to be doesn't happen.
sentences.zh: 这在我的角色中也有体现，在我目前的角色中，我看到人们想象的未来和生活并没有发生。

sentences.en: And there's a, there's a, there is, yeah, there is a, there is a struggle in moving from the fantasy to reality and reconciling that those,
sentences.zh: 并且存在着，存在着，是的，存在着，从幻想转向现实并调和这两者之间存在着挣扎，

sentences.en: those two things are never going to be the same.
sentences.zh: 这两者永远不会是相同的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So there was a small version of that for me, not, not comparable, but a version, my own version.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说有一个微缩版，虽然无法比较，但也是一个版本，我自己的版本。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对的。

sentences.en: And I feel like I want to ask you a thousand other questions about other things you've mentioned.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我想问你关于你提到的其他事情的成千上万个问题。

sentences.en: But what I want to do before we move on is to just say, gosh, well done.
sentences.zh: 但在我们继续之前，我想说的是，天哪，干得好。

sentences.en: Like, you know, you make it sound quite easy that you dropped down to part time and did a whole degree during the whole pandemic whilst working and, you know,
sentences.zh: 你看，你把它说得好像很简单，你转成了兼职，并在整个大流行期间攻读了整个学位，同时还要工作，你知道的，

sentences.en: running your own life in the background as well.
sentences.zh: 在后台还要过好你自己的生活。

sentences.en: But, you know,
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，

sentences.en: there's clearly something that really resonated with you that made you accountable to yourself and gave you permission to take yourself seriously and to do what it was you wanted.

sentences.en: And I spent a long time doing that and developing it.

sentences.en: And yeah, so in the sunk cost fallacy was it was this really clear period of time where everything everything became kind of HD.

sentences.en: And it was like none of none of this is is really worth anything to me or maybe even to anybody else.

sentences.en: And that can be a helpful thing for people to grapple with when they've been, for example, assaulted or hurt.

sentences.zh: 这就好比你现在拥有的身体，其实已经不同于当年被那个人伤害时的身体了。

sentences.zh: 这真的能帮到很多人。

sentences.en: But in thinking about recovery, mental health recovery, I think you've done something really incredible
sentences.zh: 但谈到康复，心理健康康复，我觉得你做了一件非常不可思议的事，

sentences.en: But they also ask me the same question.
sentences.zh: 但他们也会反过来问我同样的问题。

sentences.en: And, you know, I get loads of lovely things from them about their favourite and their least favourite.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我能从他们那里听到很多关于他们喜欢和不喜欢的事物的可爱回答。

sentences.en: And sometimes my most favourite day is reply is just like, it was just all right.
sentences.zh: 有时候我回答我最喜欢的一天时，答案就是“今天挺平常的”。

sentences.en: There wasn't anything particularly good.
sentences.zh: 没有什么特别好的事。

sentences.en: There wasn't anything particularly bad.
sentences.zh: 也没有什么特别坏的事。

sentences.en: It was just a day.
sentences.zh: 就只是普通的一天。

sentences.en: And isn't that just adulting, really?
sentences.zh: 而这不正是成年人生活的真实写照吗？

sentences.en: Sometimes it's a bit vanilla.
sentences.zh: 有时候生活确实有点乏味。

sentences.en: Yeah, sometimes it is a bit bland.
sentences.zh: 对，有时候确实挺平淡的。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 对，对，对，确实如此。

sentences.en: I was also thinking about, I mean, I mean, yeah, I mean, there's a lot of plateauing that goes on in life, isn't there?
sentences.zh: 我还想到，我的意思是，生活当中其实有很多平稳期，对吧？

sentences.en: Between the bumps and the troughs.
sentences.zh: 就夹在那些高潮和低谷之间。

sentences.en: But I actually like when you said, oh, maybe it's a good thing.
sentences.zh: 但我其实挺喜欢你刚才说的那种“也许这是件好事”的观点。

sentences.en: I do actually think, well, maybe in terms of like the idea of the blank canvas therapist being able to, you know, kind of absorb transference.
sentences.zh: 我确实觉得，也许从“治疗师作为一块白板”的概念来看，能够，你知道的，去承载移情作用……

sentences.en: So there's maybe something in that, maybe another way of looking at it would be that.
sentences.zh: 所以这其中可能有点门道，换个角度来看也许正是如此。

sentences.en: So maybe I should be channeling my inner bland during sessions and then I can pick up all this transference.
sentences.zh: 所以也许我应该在心理咨询期间调动我内心的这种平庸，然后我就可以接住所有的这些移情。

sentences.en: So, yeah, maybe maybe it's my secret power, my blandness, but maybe just not as a podcast gueSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，好吧，也许这就是我的超能力，我的平庸，只不过大概不适合当播客嘉宾吧。

sentences.en: I really don't think you are bland, but I think what's really brilliant about training and what you might well experience for yourself, too,
sentences.zh: 我真的不觉得你平庸，但我认为培训最精彩的地方在于，你很可能会亲自体验到这一点，

sentences.en: is that you're likely to do a variety of different approaches during training.
sentences.zh: 那就是你在培训期间很可能会尝试各种不同的治疗方法。

sentences.en: So in my first year, I was really into psychodynamic and that sort of I'd started to pave the way for psychodynamic placement for placement six.
sentences.zh: 所以在我的第一年，我非常迷恋心理动力学，那种倾向为我在第六阶段的实习铺平了道路，我开始朝着心理动力学实习方向发展。

sentences.en: But my latter interests were much more probably humanistic and I've ended up doing CFT.
sentences.zh: 但后来我的兴趣更多地转向了人本主义，最终我做了慈悲焦点疗法（CFT）。

sentences.en: So if I'd been introduced to CFT, for anyone listening who's not sure what that is, that's compassion focused therapy earlier in the process,
sentences.zh: 所以如果我能早点接触到CFT——对于正在收听却不太清楚那是什么的听众来说，那是慈悲焦点疗法——

sentences.en: I might well have done something different.
sentences.zh: 我可能早就做点别的了。

sentences.en: But what I really like about training is you get a chance to try on different hats.
sentences.zh: 但我真的很喜欢培训的一点是，你有机会去尝试扮演不同的角色。

sentences.en: So I did solution focused.
sentences.zh: 所以我做过焦点解决疗法。

sentences.en: I did systemic.
sentences.zh: 我学的是系统式心理治疗。

sentences.en: I did psychodynamic.
sentences.zh: 我学的是心理动力学。

sentences.en: And you get to see, oh, well, what happens when I when I run therapy sessions in this way?
sentences.zh: 你会发现，哦，原来当我以这种方式进行治疗时，会发生什么？

sentences.en: And then you get to think about which bits you like, which bits you want to keep and which bits you want to leave there and never use again.
sentences.zh: 然后你会思考哪些部分是你喜欢的，哪些部分你想保留，哪些部分你想留在那里再也不用。

sentences.en: And so, you know, I would empower you to try and really get I mean, some of it's not within your control,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我会鼓励你去尝试真正去理解——我的意思是，有些事情并不在你的控制范围内，

sentences.en: but to try and get as as wide a variety of exposure to different therapeutic orientations on placements as you can.
sentences.zh: 但你要尽量在实习期间接触到尽可能广泛、多样的不同治疗取向。

sentences.en: And that might even be when you're on placement, seeking out maybe someone that's not your supervisor to shadow some sessions with
sentences.zh: 甚至可能在实习时，去找一个不是你督导的人，去旁听一些面谈，

sentences.en: than to maybe have some ad hoc supervision sessions with to get a different understanding of what is likely to be a very similar population within your service,
sentences.zh: 或者进行一些临时的督导面谈，以便对你服务对象中那些非常相似的人群有不同的理解，

sentences.en: because I've learned so much from people in that way.
sentences.zh: 因为我通过这种方式从其他人身上学到了太多东西。

sentences.en: Yeah, I absolutely agree with that, especially considering trainees are trainees.
sentences.zh: 是的，我完全同意这一点，特别是考虑到实习生毕竟是实习生。

sentences.en: They are being developed from one one side to the other.
sentences.zh: 他们正在从各个方面不断成长。

sentences.en: And when they qualify, they're at the beginning of their career as a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 当他们获得资质时，他们才刚刚开始临床心理学家的职业生涯。

sentences.en: It's not that the doctorate isn't isn't the end goal.
sentences.zh: 并不是说博士学位就是最终目标。

sentences.en: It's it's the preface of the beginning.
sentences.zh: 它是……它是序言的开始。

sentences.en: And if you want to put it like that.
sentences.zh: 如果你想这样表达的话。

sentences.en: So the idea of being trained in as broad a way as possible is something that really appeals to me.
sentences.zh: 因此，接受尽可能广泛培训的想法非常吸引我。

sentences.en: It really appeals to me about the course that I'm that I'm joining.
sentences.zh: 这正是我要加入这个课程所感受到的最大吸引力。

sentences.en: It's one of the reasons why I applied for it is that they they offer training in four different models.
sentences.zh: 这也是我申请它的原因之一，因为他们提供四种不同流派的培训。

sentences.en: I'm not quite sure how I feel about CBT plus one on a lot of the courses,
sentences.zh: 我对许多课程采用的“CBT加一种”模式有点拿不准感觉，

sentences.en: given that trainees are not even qualified yet and why you would narrow it down at such an early stage in people's careers.
sentences.zh: 鉴于实习生甚至还没正式获得资质，为什么要在大家职业生涯的如此早期就进行窄化呢？

sentences.en: Not notwithstanding the fact that you can you can then qualify and you have a whole career in which to explore different things.
sentences.zh: 尽管事实是，你获得资质后，还有整个职业生涯去探索不同的事物。

sentences.en: But personally, I think the course is maybe the perfect time to explore those things.
sentences.zh: 但就我个人而言，我认为课程或许是探索这些事情的绝佳时机。

sentences.en: And I'm I've been really lucky in the service that I that I work in that I've I've been able to experience and use adapted versions of different models.
sentences.zh: 我很幸运，在我工作的机构里，我能够体验并使用不同治疗流派的改编版本。

sentences.en: Which which is which has been yeah, I should have been terrifically privileged and unfortunate that I've had that kind of AP role.
sentences.zh: 这……这让我感到——是的，我非常荣幸也很幸运能担任那种助理心理学家（AP）的角色。

sentences.en: And so, for example, for one client, we used CBT for the formulation stage, but then you CFT for the kind of intervention stage.
sentences.zh: 所以，举个例子，对于某位来访者，我们在构念阶段使用CBT，但在干预阶段则使用慈悲焦点疗法（CFT）。

sentences.en: So we kind of not not strictly, but an adapted versions of both things.
sentences.zh: 所以我们算不上——不是严格意义上的，而是两者的改编版本。

sentences.en: But we kind of just brought in elements from CFT.
sentences.zh: 但我们只是引入了CFT的一些元素。

sentences.en: And I I really like I really like that in sort of integration of different ideas and different different models.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢这种不同理念和不同流派的融合。

sentences.en: Maybe that's how I'd like to develop, but we'll but we'll see again in that seven year cycle or probably completely different to how I am now.
sentences.zh: 也许这就是我想发展的方式，但我们拭目以待，在那个七年周期里，可能和我现在的状态完全不同。

sentences.en: So but yeah, I'm looking forward to exploring that that broad range.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我很期待去探索那种广泛的领域。

sentences.en: And especially given that, you know, when we think about the therapeutic alliance being the biggest predictor of a positive outcome.
sentences.zh: 特别是考虑到，当我们认为治疗同盟是取得积极治疗效果的最强预测指标时。

sentences.en: Doesn't exactly render the model or the choice.
sentences.zh: 这并不完全意味着流派或选择变得无关紧要。

sentences.en: It doesn't render the choice irrelevant, but it does mean that, you know,
sentences.zh: 它并非让这种选择变得毫无意义，但确实意味着，

sentences.en: exploring different models means that you can catch one that really sort of resonates with you and you feel just is a kind of path of least resistance.
sentences.zh: 探索不同的流派意味着你能找到一个真正与你产生共鸣、让你觉得阻力最小的路径。

sentences.en: I can use this.
sentences.zh: 我可以用这个。

sentences.en: I know it.
sentences.zh: 我懂它。

sentences.en: It feels right.
sentences.zh: 感觉很对。

sentences.en: It feels good.
sentences.zh: 感觉很好。

sentences.en: I'm good at it.
sentences.zh: 我很擅长它。

sentences.en: And that gives you maybe more of an opportunity to develop that therapeutic alliance and more opportunity to have positive outcomes.
sentences.zh: 这或许能给你更多机会去建立这种治疗同盟，并有更多机会取得积极的成果。

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And I've become and this isn't it.
sentences.zh: 而且我变得——而且这还不是……

sentences.en: Yeah, I think let's let's go back to your earlier point.
sentences.zh: 对，我想我们还是回到你刚才的那个观点吧。

sentences.en: You're you're worthy of race and you're allowed to say good things about yourself and you're allowed others to say good things about you.
sentences.zh: 你值得被赞赏，你被允许对自己说好话，也允许别人对你说好话。

sentences.en: So I'm going to say something good about myself now to model that.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在要夸夸自己，来做个表率。

sentences.en: But I'm a much better clinical psychologist now than I was when I qualified as we are expected to be.
sentences.zh: 但我现在是一个比刚获得资质时优秀得多的临床心理学家，正如我们本该如此那样。

sentences.en: You know, really, it's kind of thinking about the first couple of years as being preceptorship.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，实际上，就是把前几年当作导师指导期（Preceptorship）。

sentences.en: And then really, you're fully qualified a couple of years later.
sentences.zh: 然后几年后，你才真正完全具备独立执业资格。

sentences.en: You know, it's certainly felt like the case for me.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我自己的经历确实如此。

sentences.en: I've become better and better as years have gone on.
sentences.zh: 随着岁月的流逝，我变得越来越好。

sentences.en: But I would say that I'm now truly an integrative psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 但我可以说，我现在真正成了一名整合型心理学家。

sentences.en: And what I really love about this stage of my career is that, yeah, every client has a different intervention because it's bespoke for them.
sentences.zh: 我职业生涯现阶段最喜欢的是，是的，每个来访者都有不同的干预方案，因为这是为他们量身定制的。

sentences.en: And if something stops working or if something resonates with them in a session, I will literally go, right, OK.
sentences.zh: 如果某种方法停止起效，或者如果有什么方法在会谈中与他们产生共鸣，我就会直接说：好，行。

sentences.en: And there might even be a, uh, as I think about that, I touch my mouth.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能还会伴随着，嗯，当我想到这一点时，我摸了摸嘴巴。

sentences.en: I do that.
sentences.zh: 我确实会这样。

sentences.en: I do do that.
sentences.zh: 我真的会这样做。

sentences.en: Um, and I'll look off to the right and then I'll dig into my therapeutic toolbox.
sentences.zh: 嗯，然后我会把目光投向右边，接着在我的治疗工具箱里深挖。

sentences.en: It's like rummaging in an old doctor's bag.
sentences.zh: 就像在一个老旧的医生出诊包里翻找一样。

sentences.en: And I will find something that is going to be transformative for them.
sentences.zh: 我会找到能为他们带来改变的东西。

sentences.en: Um, that's just the best job in the world.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这简直是世界上最好的工作。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: Being able to pull across.
sentences.zh: 能够融会贯通各种方法。

sentences.en: So sometimes it will be an idea from psychodynamic.
sentences.zh: 所以有时会用到心理动力学的一个理念。

sentences.en: Sometimes it will be an idea from systemic.
sentences.zh: 有时会用到系统式治疗的一个理念。

sentences.en: Sometimes it will be something completely random that I've made up for them that will resonate because it's got, um, you know, like an analogy.
sentences.zh: 有时会用到我为他们完全随机编造的东西，只要能产生共鸣就行，因为里面包含了一种比喻。

sentences.en: So I've used, um, recently I've used the idea of, I don't know if you're a gardener Thomas, I don't know if that's yet hit your world.
sentences.zh: 比如我用过，嗯，最近我用过这样一个概念——托马斯，我不知道你是不是个园艺爱好者，我不知道这事儿你接触过没有。

sentences.en: But, um, climbing plants will send out little shoots.
sentences.zh: 但是，嗯，攀缘植物会伸出小芽。

sentences.en: Um, and I've used that to help somebody understand OCD and to help externalize that, um, to kind of think about it desperately looking for support and reassurance.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我用这个来帮助某人理解强迫症（OCD），并帮助他们把强迫症外化，嗯，去想象它拼命寻求支持和安心的样子。

sentences.en: And, you know, so it's not going to blow over in the wind, but actually it's a bit of a, it's a bit of a lie, you know, OCD.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，这样它就不会被风吹倒，但实际上，这有点像是一个谎言，你知道的，强迫症。

sentences.en: It's a whole nother episode, but, um, that has been really helpful.
sentences.zh: 这是另一集的内容了，不过，嗯，这真的非常有用。

sentences.en: Um, and so I'm just excited for where you're going and for this growth explosion you're going to have and you, your brain is going to basically rewire itself,
sentences.zh: 所以，我很为你未来的去向以及你即将迎来的爆发式成长感到兴奋，你的大脑基本上会进行重新布线，

sentences.en: which is also really exciting.
sentences.zh: 这也是非常令人兴奋的。

sentences.en: You know, we think about that happening in key areas of, you know, adolescence, a childhood growing adolescence.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们认为这种现象发生在青春期的关键领域，童年到青春期的成长。

sentences.en: Um, but when we also start a new job, we'll suddenly often notice, oh, I can't sleep very well.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但当我们开始一份新工作时，往往也会突然注意到：哦，我觉睡不好了。

sentences.en: I'm fizzed up with ideas.
sentences.zh: 我脑子里充满了各种想法。

sentences.en: My brain is trying to process everything, but it really is an exciting period of change and growth.
sentences.zh: 我的大脑正在试图处理所有事情，但这确实是一个充满兴奋的变革与成长时期。

sentences.en: I'm, I'm really excited for you to experience that.
sentences.zh: 我，我真的很高兴你能体验到这一点。

sentences.en: And I hope that you find it to be a really positive experience.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能觉得这是一段非常积极的经历。

sentences.en: Um, yeah, same.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对，我也是。

sentences.en: And does it, does, yeah, I had a lot of thoughts when you, when you talking through all of that.
sentences.zh: 而且，当你在讲述所有这些的时候，我确实，我确实有很多想法。

sentences.en: Um, I mean, I suppose I'm quite committed to the idea of the continuous development, the idea that I'll be a complete finished clinician at any stage isn't really,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是说，我想我对持续发展的理念非常坚定，那种认为我在任何阶段都能成为一个完全成熟、定型的临床医生的想法，其实并……

sentences.en: isn't really in my thought.
sentences.zh: 其实并不在我的考虑范围内。

sentences.en: So, yeah, in terms of like keeping my brain ticking over from here, from here on in is, is, is really, is really comforting.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，就从现在开始让我的大脑保持活跃而言，真的，真的让人感到安慰。

sentences.en: It's, I really like it.
sentences.zh: 这感觉很好，我真的很喜欢。

sentences.en: I've plateaued a lot, uh, in my working life.
sentences.zh: 在我的职业生涯中，我经历过很多次瓶颈期，嗯。

sentences.en: Um, so the idea that there, there may be no more plateaus is, is quite, is quite nice.
sentences.zh: 所以，那种以后可能不会再有瓶颈期的想法，让人感觉相当，相当不错。

sentences.en: Um, and I'm, yeah, I'm, I'm definitely up for that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且我，是的，我绝对愿意接受这一点。

sentences.en: That's, that's also part of the appeal of, of going into clinical psychology.
sentences.zh: 这也是，这也是选择从事临床心理学吸引人的一部分原因。

sentences.en: And, um, I suppose, going, going into a science where we're, we're kind of all at the same time, we're, we're, we're at the, the, the absolute limit of our understanding,
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，我想，进入一门科学领域，我们在其中——我们同时处于我们理解力的绝对极限，

sentences.en: but we're also already behind where we're going to be.
sentences.zh: 但我们同时也已经落后于我们未来将要达到的高度。

sentences.en: Um, and I, that really appeals to me.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这真的非常吸引我。

sentences.en: I'm quite comfortable.
sentences.zh: 我感到挺自在的。

sentences.en: I feel quite comfortable being in that position.
sentences.zh: 处于这种状态让我觉得挺舒服的。

sentences.en: And I suppose, um, in my own development, I'm quite comfortable knowing where I am, but knowing also where I might be.
sentences.zh: 而且我想，在我的自身发展中，我很清楚自己现在在哪里，但同时也清楚自己未来可能会在哪里，这让我觉得很笃定。

sentences.en: Because when you're talking about, um, developing after qualification, having the experience to integrate different models, that's,
sentences.zh: 因为当你谈到，嗯，在获得资质后继续成长、具备整合不同流派的经验时，那就是——

sentences.en: I'm really looking forward to being able to do that.
sentences.zh: 我非常期待自己能够做到这一点。

sentences.en: Um, and I've seen it, of course, in more experienced colleagues.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当然，我在更有经验的同事身上看到过这一点。

sentences.en: Um, and, you know, I do occasionally fanboy a little bit over them.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且，你知道的，我偶尔确实会对他们有点狂热崇拜。

sentences.en: Um, um, but I also know that if I just keep going, just keep working hard, get a bit of luck, then I'll, I'll get there as well eventually.
sentences.zh: 嗯，嗯，但我同时也知道，如果我坚持下去，继续努力工作，再加上一点运气，那我终究也会达到那个水平。

sentences.en: Um, so, but I'm, I'm quite comfortable and happy about like where I am now versus where I was.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以，对于我现在的状态与过去的对比，我感到相当舒适和开心。

sentences.en: And I'm quite excited about where I am now versus where I, I might be.
sentences.zh: 而且对于我现在的状态与我未来可能达到的状态的对比，我感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: And yes, and yes, I do like, I also do like gardening as well.
sentences.zh: 而且是的，而且是的，我的确挺喜欢，我也很喜欢园艺。

sentences.en: I have an allotment.
sentences.zh: 我有一块分配地（菜园）。

sentences.en: Good to know.
sentences.zh: 很高兴知道这一点。

sentences.en: Oh, how lovely.
sentences.zh: 哦，太棒了。

sentences.en: How lovely.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Another, uh, 40s vibe, I think, is burnt orange on an allotment.
sentences.zh: 我觉得分配地里穿焦橙色，是另一种40年代的复古风情。

sentences.en: What's your most successful produce this year?
sentences.zh: 你今年收获最成功的农作物是什么？

sentences.en: Oh, gosh.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Um, the, well, this year has been weird because July hasn't happened basically or all the, all the rain has been in the wrong place.
sentences.zh: 嗯，今年很奇怪，因为基本上七月份好像根本没过一样，或者说所有的雨都下错了地方。

sentences.en: The sun has been in the wrong place.
sentences.zh: 阳光照错了地方。

sentences.en: Uh, the, the, the cold weather was in the wrong place.
sentences.zh: 嗯，寒冷的天气也来错了地方。

sentences.en: So goodness knows what it's like to be, um, a plant.
sentences.zh: 所以天知道当一株植物是什么感觉。

sentences.en: The radishes haven't fared well, I believe this year.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，今年萝卜长得不太好。

sentences.en: Not been enough water at, at key times.
sentences.zh: 在关键时期没有得到足够的水分。

sentences.en: Um, at the moment, I think, so my partner grows flowers, so we have lots of flowers.
sentences.zh: 嗯，目前我觉得，我的伴侣种了花，所以我们有很多花。

sentences.en: They're all looking good.
sentences.zh: 它们看起来都很不错。

sentences.en: Um, so I think maybe beetroot looks okay.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以我想红菜头（甜菜根）看起来还可以吧。

sentences.en: Oh, nice.
sentences.zh: 哦，不错。

sentences.en: Um, good.
sentences.zh: 嗯，很好。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Good veg, good veg, good veg update.
sentences.zh: 好蔬菜，好蔬菜，蔬菜情况汇报完毕。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Um, I, I, I do think there is value in the plateau though, and we can't keep relentlessly striving all the time.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我，我，我确实认为瓶颈期也有它的价值，我们不可能一直马不停蹄地奋斗。

sentences.en: Um, because it's exhausting.
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为这太累人了。

sentences.en: And sometimes we do need to go to supervision and go, can't be bothered.
sentences.zh: 有时我们确实需要去做督导，然后说：我实在没法子了。

sentences.en: I can't seem to make any shifts.
sentences.zh: 我似乎没有任何突破。

sentences.en: I can't seem to make any changes.
sentences.zh: 我似乎无法做出任何改变。

sentences.en: You know, I'm managing my work, but it is what it is.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我在应付工作，但现状就是这样。

sentences.en: You know, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我不知道。

sentences.en: And I think you've got to be able to have that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你必须能够拥有这种状态。

sentences.en: But even in supervision sessions, sometimes I will learn so much, um,
sentences.zh: 但即使在督导会谈中，有时我也能学到很多东西，嗯，

sentences.en: because we should ideally always have a supervisor who's more experienced than ourselves to be able to help contain us, to be able to help shape us and to help us grow.
sentences.zh: 因为理想情况下，我们总是需要一位比我们更有经验的督导，来帮助我们保持定力，帮助我们塑造自我，并协助我们成长。

sentences.en: And to help us think about being able to overcome things from a different perspective than the one that we're currently feeling a bit trapped in so that our clients can,
sentences.zh: 并帮助我们从不同于当前那种让我们觉得有点受困的视角去克服困难，好让我们的来访者也能，

sentences.en: can benefit from, you know, the safety, the security, the growth of, you know, of the supervision relationship as well.
sentences.zh: 也能受益于督导关系所带来的安全感、稳定感以及成长。

sentences.en: And I guess I'd welcome your thoughts on that.
sentences.zh: 我想我也很乐意听听你对此的看法。

sentences.en: Um, yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的。

sentences.en: So most of what I say about five minutes after I say it, I reflect and think, oh, it's probably not, that's not, that's not quite right, is it?
sentences.zh: 所以我说的话，通常在说出口五分钟后，我就会反思并心想：哦，这大概不对，这——这不太对劲吧？

sentences.en: That's not quite true.
sentences.zh: 这并不是十分准确。

sentences.en: Um, so that's, yeah, I'm a chronic ruminator, a chronic reflector.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以，是的，我是一个长期的反刍者、长期的反思者。

sentences.en: Um, so when I said that about no more plateaus, I did, I did think, well, yeah, there will be, and there's value in the plateau with consolidation of what you know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以当我之前说“不再有瓶颈期”时，我确实——我确实想过，嗯，对，其实还会有瓶颈期，而瓶颈期对于巩固你所学的东西是有价值的。

sentences.en: Um, yeah, you can't consolidate if you're constantly learning.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果你一直在不断学习，你就无法进行巩固。

sentences.en: Um, so that, I guess there has to be that, that kind of period where it all kind of settles and you become confident in, in what you've learned and what you know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以，我想必定会有那样一个阶段，一切都沉淀下来，你对所学和所知的内容充满信心。

sentences.en: Um, so yeah, sure.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以，没错，当然。

sentences.en: So, uh, yeah, if we're constantly feeling like there's stuff to learn, then we're going to constantly begin to believe that we don't know anything and we're not enough.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，是的，如果我们一直觉得有学不完的东西，那我们就会不断开始相信自己什么都不会，自己还不够好。

sentences.en: So sometimes there has to be that feeling of mastery.
sentences.zh: 所以有时候必须要有那种掌握了技能的感觉。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, I get this.
sentences.zh: 哦，对，我懂这个。

sentences.en: And this is what I say, um, I've said before on the podcast is that in a cohort,
sentences.zh: 这就是我想说的，嗯，我以前在播客里也说过，在一个群体里，

sentences.en: sometimes you will be so blown away by the experiences that people in your cohort are talking about.
sentences.zh: 有时你会对群体里其他人所谈论的经历感到无比惊叹。

sentences.en: And the, the level of comfortability that they're able to demonstrate for a particular topic and you'll be like, oh God, I don't know anything about that.
sentences.zh: 还有他们能够针对某个特定主题表现出的松弛感，你会觉得，天哪，我对那个一无所知。

sentences.en: And that makes you feel quite squirmy in your tummy.
sentences.zh: 这会让你心里感到一阵局促不安。

sentences.en: It makes you feel not enough,
sentences.zh: 这会让你觉得自己不够优秀，

sentences.en: but actually other times there will be stuff that you have such a rich understanding of and such a sense of mastery in comparison to perhaps what others in the cohort will have.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，另一些时候，你会对某些事物有非常深刻的理解和掌握，相比之下，群体里的其他人可能就没那么了解。

sentences.en: And that's what makes clinical psychology really special because you've all got to the start line, but with very different skills, experiences and abilities.
sentences.zh: 这就是临床心理学非常特别的地方，因为你们都站在了同一起跑线上，却拥有非常不同的技能、经历和能力。

sentences.en: And I think that's very, very special.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这非常非常特别。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 对，完全同意。

sentences.en: Um, I completely subscribe to the idea that everybody knows something you don't and that is why no one ever achieves anything completely by themselves in a vacuum.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我完全赞同这样一种观点：每个人都有你不知道的事情，这就是为什么没有人能完全靠自己孤立地取得任何成就。

sentences.en: I don't think any human has ever achieved something without any input from someone else.
sentences.zh: 我认为没有任何人类是在没有任何他人输入的情况下取得过成就的。

sentences.en: Every supervisor I've ever had, every client I've ever had comes with me and teachers and stuff comes with me throughout my career.
sentences.zh: 我遇到的每一位督导、每一位来访者，都一直伴随着我，还有那些老师之类的人，都在我的职业生涯中一直陪伴着我。

sentences.en: And it's not just me and my determination.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是我和我的决心。

sentences.en: There's a whole host of luck as well that's happened along the way that's got me to being the professional and the person that I am.
sentences.zh: 一路上还有大量的运气，才让我成为了今天的专业人士和我自己。

sentences.en: Yeah, the two supervisors I've had live rent-free in my head, definitely.
sentences.zh: 对，我遇到过的那两位督导确实永远活在我的脑海里，毋庸置疑。

sentences.en: Um, and I've been, I've been really lucky to have two very different supervisors at two very different points in their career.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我很幸运，能在职业生涯的两个完全不同的阶段遇到两位非常不同的督导。

sentences.en: So my, my first, so I've been, I've been an AP for just, just under two years.
sentences.zh: 所以我的，我的第一位，我在助理心理学家（AP）的岗位上干了差不多快两年。

sentences.en: Um, so roughly speaking, the first year was with a supervisor of 40 years experience, um, seeing it all, done it all, um, was very, um, I thought just brilliant, wonderful person,
sentences.zh: 嗯，粗略地说，第一年是一位拥有40年经验的督导，嗯，见多识广，经验丰富，嗯，我当时觉得他真是一个绝佳、非常棒的人，

sentences.en: um, and quite psychodynamic, psychodynamically minded.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且非常有心理动力学的心态。

sentences.en: So supervision was very open, free form, no agenda, no structure.
sentences.zh: 所以督导非常开放、自由、没有议程、也没有结构。

sentences.en: Um, and we would often talk about growing flowers as well.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们还经常聊到种花的事情。

sentences.en: Um, and then my new supervisor, uh, was newly qualified, um, on a preceptorship.
sentences.zh: 嗯，然后我的新督导，呃，是一位刚拿到资格的新人，处于试用过渡期。

sentences.en: So part of their training towards band eight, uh, was to have a supervisee and I was that, I was that supervisee.
sentences.zh: 所以他们朝八级晋升的培训的一部分，就是带一个被督导者，而我就是那个人，我就是那个被督导者。

sentences.en: So it was their first experience of being a clinical psychologist, their first, um, supervisor, their first role as a supervisor.
sentences.zh: 所以这是他们第一次当临床心理学家，他们的第一位，呃，督导，他们作为督导的第一个角色。

sentences.en: And, um, whereas my first supervisor, um, was approaching retirement, um, my new supervisor just qualified.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，我的第一位督导，嗯，正接近退休，嗯，我的新督导则是刚获得资格。

sentences.en: And although I don't know how old they are, they are definitely a lot younger than me, maybe 10 ish years younger than me, maybe a little bit more.
sentences.zh: 虽然我不知道他们的确切年龄，但他们绝对比我年轻得多，可能比我年轻10岁左右，也许还要多一点。

sentences.en: Um, and that's something that we talked about early on in terms of how I felt about that, which for the record was absolutely fine.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是我们在早期就讨论过的事情，关于我对这点的看法，记录在案的是，这绝对没问题。

sentences.en: Um, my age doesn't, I'm not like, uh, I don't feel any kind of ego about my age or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的年龄不，我不是那种，呃，我对自己的年龄没有任何自我意识或类似的情绪。

sentences.en: I deferred to their role, their qualification, their level of experience and, um, expertise.
sentences.zh: 我尊重他们的角色、他们的资格、他们的经验水平以及，呃，专业知识。

sentences.en: Um, but also we talked about how they felt about having a significantly younger supervisor, uh, supervisee and even potentially the idea that,
sentences.zh: 嗯，但我们也讨论了他们对于拥有一个比自己大得多被督导者有什么感觉，甚至还讨论了这样一种想法，

sentences.en: that they may never have in the rest of their career, a supervisee who is 10 or more years older than them.
sentences.zh: 那就是在他们余下的职业生涯中，可能再也不会遇到一个比自己大10岁或更多的被督导者了。

sentences.en: Um, and I guess the older that they get, the, the less likely that will be, you know, when they're 50, it's even more unlikely that, um, their supervisee will be in their sixties.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想他们年龄越大，这种可能性就越小，你知道的，当他们50岁时，他们的被督导者在60多岁的可能性就更小了。

sentences.en: Um, so yeah, we, we discussed that and that's, I mean, it hasn't created any barriers, I don't think.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以是的，我们讨论过这个，而且，这并没有造成任何障碍，我认为没有。

sentences.en: Um, but it's, I think partly has maybe, maybe we could talk about age as power in terms of the social graces, um, because there have been occasions, I think,
sentences.zh: 嗯，但我认为部分原因可能，也许我们可以从社会礼仪的角度把年龄视为一种权力，因为确实有过这样的时刻，我认为，

sentences.en: where there's been a two way, um, a two, two way relationship in terms of learning and maybe even driving particular things, um, where, where, whereby I've kind of felt as a team,
sentences.zh: 在学习方面存在一种双向的，呃，双向的关系，甚至可能在推动某些具体事情方面，呃，在这种情况下，我作为团队的一员曾觉得，

sentences.en: we're not doing this and we should be.
sentences.zh: 我们不能这样做，我们应该那样做。

sentences.en: And I've been the one to kind of lead it.
sentences.zh: 而且我一直是那种带头去做的人。

sentences.en: Um, but then again, my, my current supervisor, um, is a believer in kind of collective leadership.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不过话说回来，我现任的督导，嗯，是集体领导力的信仰者。

sentences.en: Um, so it's also, there's also been that space for me to do that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以这也是一个让我能够这样做的空间。

sentences.en: It's not just simply because I'm old and I'm like, well, I know better, um, cause that just isn't the case.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是因为我年纪大，然后觉得，嗯，我知道得更多，呃，因为事实根本不是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And I think you absolutely can get assertive and great leaders from a young age,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为你绝对可以从很小的时候就培养出自信且优秀的领导者，

sentences.en: but it's something that I've developed as I've aged and my confidence for being able to just observe, stop, think, and suggest and intervene.
sentences.zh: 但这随着我的年龄增长而有所发展，我的自信心让我能够去观察、停下、思考、建议并进行干预。

sentences.en: And, um, you know, I'm very much less likely to put up with any kind of social injustice or, you know, um, inequality in the team,
sentences.zh: 而且，呃，你知道，我更不可能容忍团队中的任何社会不公，或者，呃，不平等，

sentences.en: or if I think that something's not happening that should be happening, I'm very much more likely to advocate for that now.
sentences.zh: 或者如果我认为有些本该发生的事情没有发生，我现在更有可能为此大声疾呼。

sentences.en: And I think it's just my age and my experience that has allowed that to happen.
sentences.zh: 我想这只是我的年龄和经验让这一切得以发生。

sentences.en: But of course, like I said, there are younger people who've, who've got there much quicker than I have.
sentences.zh: 但当然，就像我说的，也有一些年轻人，他们比我更快地达到了那个位置。

sentences.en: I'm just conscious.
sentences.zh: 我只是在留意时间。

sentences.en: Um, for those of you who don't know, I am still a practicing clinician.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对于那些不知道的人，我依然是一名在职的临床医生。

sentences.en: So I've got, I do see a clinical caseload.
sentences.zh: 所以我身上确实有临床病历的工作量。

sentences.en: I'm just conscious of time because, um, I've got a clinical session very shortly, but before we finish, I'd really love to know what your top tips are for reducing burnout, um, in,
sentences.zh: 我只是注意到时间不多了，因为，呃，我很快就有一个临床会话，但在我们结束之前，Tom，我真的很想知道你对减少，呃，在我们这个职业中的职业倦怠有哪些顶级建议。

sentences.en: in this career of ours, Tom.
sentences.zh: 在，在这个职业中，Tom。

sentences.en: Um, um, so I, I think that partly because of my age and knowing that time passes quite quickly.
sentences.zh: 嗯，嗯，所以我想，部分是因为我的年龄，并且知道时间过得很快。

sentences.en: So there's no need to rush.
sentences.zh: 所以没有必要着急。

sentences.en: It's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 该发生的总会发生。

sentences.en: That kind of helps me not have my foot too hard on the pedal to begin with.
sentences.zh: 这种心态一开始帮我避免了把油门踩得太死。

sentences.en: Um, and they, again, I think through age and experience, that's, that's a skill that I've learned, uh, to kind of not throw, throw all of myself in, into something.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且同样地，我认为通过年龄和经验，这已经成为我学会的一项技能，呃，就是不要把自己的全部都投入到某件事情中去。

sentences.en: So that's not to say that I don't throw myself into this career, but I'm maybe, you know, it's maybe like eight out of 10.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说我不投入到这个职业中，但我可能，你知道，它可能就像十分之八。

sentences.en: My foot is eight out of 10 on the pedal.
sentences.zh: 我的脚踩在油门上的力度是十分之八。

sentences.en: That's a really bad way of putting it, but if you get my meaning, um, because this isn't sustainable.
sentences.zh: 这个比喻打得真烂，但如果你懂我的意思的话，因为这并不是可持续的。

sentences.en: So I guess in reality, what that means is, uh, well, just referring back to what you said earlier, there are days when I just can't be bothered.
sentences.zh: 所以我想实际上，这意味着，呃，就像回顾你刚才所说的那样，总有那么几天我就是什么都不想做。

sentences.en: I love my job.
sentences.zh: 我热爱我的工作。

sentences.en: I love my colleagues.
sentences.zh: 我热爱我的同事。

sentences.en: I love the clients that I work for.
sentences.zh: 我热爱我服务的来访者。

sentences.en: Um, in fact, it's maybe the first, you know, it's the first time I've loved my job.
sentences.zh: 嗯，事实上，这可能是第一，你知道，这是我第一次这么热爱我的工作。

sentences.en: Um, and the, and in spite of that, there are still days when I just cannot be bothered.
sentences.zh: 嗯，尽管如此，仍然有些日子我就是什么都不想干。

sentences.en: And there are clients that I've struggled to really engage with and engage with the work.
sentences.zh: 而且总有那么一些来访者，我很难真正与他们建立联系并开展工作。

sentences.en: Uh, so when that happens, it's fine.
sentences.zh: 呃，所以当这种情况发生时，没关系。

sentences.en: Just sink into it and let it, let it pass and just give yourself a break.
sentences.zh: 沉浸其中，顺其自然，让它过去，放自己一马。

sentences.en: Um, and also when it's time to go home, I go home and at the weekend, I don't, I don't think about my job and I don't think about it at night.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且到了该回家的时候，我就回家，在周末，我不去想我的工作，到了晚上我也不去想它。

sentences.en: I guess I have a good work life balance.
sentences.zh: 我想我拥有很好的工作与生活平衡。

sentences.en: I suppose that's a really simple way of putting it.
sentences.zh: 我想这是一种非常简单的表达方式。

sentences.en: Um, but on the Monday morning, I haven't thought about what we talked about on Friday and supervision.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但是在周一早上，我根本没有想过我们在周五的督导中谈论过什么。

sentences.en: It just hasn't crossed my mind.
sentences.zh: 这根本没有掠过我的脑海。

sentences.en: Um, sometimes it does.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有时候也会想。

sentences.en: That's not, it's not black and white, but generally speaking, I, I managed to, to just leave it inside my shut laptop on a Friday.
sentences.zh: 这不是说，这不是非黑即白的，但总的来说，我，我设法在周五把工作留在合上的笔记本电脑里。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: Um, but I don't know how, I don't know how that's developed really.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但我不知道怎么，我真的不知道这是怎么发展出来的。

sentences.en: Maybe juSt.
sentences.zh: 也许只是。

sentences.en: I think it's containment.
sentences.zh: 我认为那是心理容纳（containment）。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Containment.
sentences.zh: 心理容纳。

sentences.en: It's as, as you grow, you just get better at doing that, I think.
sentences.zh: 随着，随着你的成长，你只是越来越擅长这样做，我认为。

sentences.en: And it's really important to develop and cultivate as a skill and to know that you don't not care about your clients because you're not thinking about them,
sentences.zh: 而且将其作为一项技能进行发展和培养是非常重要的，要知道你不是因为不考虑来访者就不在乎他们，

sentences.en: but you deserve to have your life and the two are separate.
sentences.zh: 而是你应得拥有你自己的生活，这两者是分开的。

sentences.en: And I was thinking, I love the analogy about the pedal to the metal.
sentences.zh: 我刚才在想，我很喜欢踩油门到底那个比喻。

sentences.en: You know, when you are driving with, or even if you're walking past somebody that is doing 10 out of 10 pedal to the metal, it's distressing.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当你开车时，或者甚至当你走过一个把油门踩到十分满、速度开到极限的人身旁时，那是令人心力交瘁的。

sentences.en: It's inconvenient.
sentences.zh: 那是不方便的。

sentences.en: You know, it makes you go, oh, it's exhausting.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这会让你觉得，哦，太累了。

sentences.en: And so whilst you might think you need to be relentless all the time, it's really not nice in a team if someone is doing that, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，虽然你可能认为你需要一直不知疲倦，但如果团队里有人这样做，真的感觉很不好，你知道，

sentences.en: and I've absolutely been relentless at points in my career that have probably been quite hard to be around because I'm like,
sentences.zh: 而且我在职业生涯的某些阶段也确实不知疲倦过，和那样的人在一起可能会挺难受的，因为我想的是，

sentences.en: this service needs a shorter way to list and I'm going to show you that we're doing it, we're doing it, we're doing it.
sentences.zh: 这个服务需要缩短等待名单，我要向你们证明我们在做，我们在做，我们在做。

sentences.en: Like, because these clients deserve a better service.
sentences.zh: 就像，因为这些来访者值得更好的服务。

sentences.en: And I'm sure that was difficult for my colleagues at times because I was like, productivity to me, it's accountability, 50% face to face, you know, I can do it, we can all do it,
sentences.zh: 我确信这有时对我的同事来说很难受，因为我觉得，生产力对我来说就是问责制，50%的面对面，你知道，我能做到，我们所有人都能做到，

sentences.en: let's get it done, let's get these clients to have a better experience.
sentences.zh: 把它干完，让这些来访者有更好的体验。

sentences.en: But if you do that all the time, you're not going to be very well liked and you're going to burn out and, you know,
sentences.zh: 但如果你一直这样做，你不会很受欢迎，而且你会筋疲力尽，你知道，

sentences.en: ultimately you're not going to be any use to the service or the clients that you so badly want to support.
sentences.zh: 最终你对那个服务或你如此迫切想要支持的来访者将毫无用处。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 对，完全同意。

sentences.en: I suppose to complete the analogy, you know, the more revs you use, the more petrol you burn.
sentences.zh: 我想为了完善这个比喻，你知道，你转速越高，消耗的汽油就越多。

sentences.en: Oh, you certainly do.
sentences.zh: 哦，确实如此。

sentences.en: And on that note, Tom, I'm really sorry, I'm going to have to go,
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，Tom，真的很抱歉，我得走了，

sentences.en: but it's been the biggest pleasure speaking with you and wishing you so well for these next three years and beyond.
sentences.zh: 但能和你交谈真是莫大的荣幸，祝你接下来的三年及以后一切都好。

sentences.en: And if you want to come back on the podcast at any stage, give me a shout and, you know, I'm here for you if you need any containment or advice, feel free to slip into my DMs.
sentences.zh: 如果你在任何阶段想再次来做客播客，打个招呼就行，你知道，如果你需要任何心理容纳或建议，我都在这，随时可以发私信找我。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我，Marianne。

sentences.en: I hope it wasn't bland.

sentences.zh: 一点也不无趣，它充满活力，带着焦橙色，祝你们的甜菜根繁荣昌盛。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: What a great note to finish on.
sentences.zh: 多么棒的收尾啊。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。
